description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute, which extends HTMLPurifier_URIFilter to convert relative URIs to absolute URIs based on a base URI, including methods for preparing configuration, filtering URIs, and collapsing path stacks.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute
classes.description: A class that converts relative URIs to absolute URIs based on a base URI, handling path collapsing and URI components.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration, setting the base URI and preparing the path stack.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Converts relative URIs to absolute URIs based on the base URI, handling various URI components.

methods.name: _collapseStack
methods.description: Resolves '.' and '..' segments in a URI path stack to simplify the path.
